Subsection 5.13.2: Recovery Plan Submission requires Upon receipt of a Delay Notice, the Supplier must, within seven (7) days or any other period stated in the Delay Notice, submit to Buyer a recovery plan.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Subsection 5.13.3: Recovery Plan Content requires "The Supplier shall prepare and submit a detailed plan ("Recovery Plan") at its own risk and cost setting out the various measures that it intends to implement in order to recover the delay to the works and milestone dates and eliminate the causes and events which are resulting in such delay, inadequacy, deficiency, or failure, and shall include, but not limited to the following: (a) mobilization of additional equipment and personnel; (b) working overtime, increasing the number of shifts or work days or both; (c) expediting delivery of materials by airlifting; (d) enhancing the manufacturing and fabrication capacity; (e) substitution of higher-grade materials or specifications (with prior written authorization of Buyer).". Subsection 5.13.4: Recovery Plan Approval requires The Recovery Plan shall be subject to Buyer#s approval and acceptance and shall be implemented at the Supplier's sole cost.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Subsection 5.13.5: Remedial Measures requires In the event the Supplier fails to submit the Recovery Plan or the submitted Recovery Plan is not acceptable to the Buyer, then the Supplier must, at his sole risk, cost, and expense, implement any remedial measures Buyer may require or instruct.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Subsection 5.13.6: L&T Resource Deployment allows If, in L&T#s sole opinion, Supplier's performance or progress is inadequate, deficient, and/or unsatisfactory and the Supplier may fail to achieve any or all of the milestone dates, L&T may deputes its own resources at Supplier's Group for expediting purpose. Item 11.12.2: Non-extendable Delivery Grounds describes The following shall not afford the Supplier a ground for extension of time for delivery of materials:. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.2: Non-extendable Delivery Grounds includes clause Inclement or unforeseen weather, strike or lock-out, shutdown, third party breach, delay in payment or commercial hardship shutdown or idleness or other impediment in progress or completion of the supply or work due to any reason whatsoever shall not afford the Supplier a ground for extension of time or relieve the Supplier of his/its full obligations under the contract.. Item 11.12.2: Non-extendable Delivery Grounds includes clause Delay in the supply of any material to Supplier due to any whatsoever reasons (including Force Majeure) from Supplier's vendors/sub-suppliers / sub-contractors shall not entitle Supplier for any extension of time for completion or to any claim for costs/loss/remuneration or damages or compensation whatsoever.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.3: Force Majeure Performance Excuse describes If either Party is rendered unable, wholly or in part, by Force Majeure to perform its obligations under this Purchase Order, it is agreed that performance of such obligations by such Party, so far as they are affected by Force Majeure, shall be excused from the inception of any such inability until it is corrected or relieved, but for no longer period.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.3: Force Majeure Performance Excuse requires notification written notice of the act, event, or circumstance that constitutes the event of Force Majeure, the date on which such event of Force Majeure commenced, with proper substantiation (duly certified by the local Chamber of Commerce or statutory authorities, relevant to the Supplier).. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.3: Force Majeure Performance Excuse requires delivery within three (3) days after the date on which such Party first had knowledge of the effect of such event of Force Majeure.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.3: Force Majeure Performance Excuse requires prompt action Either party shall forthwith inform the effect of the event of Force Majeure on the affected Party's ability to perform its obligations under this Purchase Order.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.3: Force Majeure Performance Excuse requires mitigation The Party claiming inability to perform must make all reasonable efforts to minimize the delay caused to the Works as a result of the occurrence of an event of Force Majeure and mitigate any other effects of Force Majeure.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.
Item 11.12.4: Mitigation and Coordination under Force Majeure describes Affected parties shall diligently mitigate or remove the effect of Force Majeure.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.4: Mitigation and Coordination under Force Majeure requires coordination Each party shall upon receipt of the Notice of Force Majeure under the preceding Article shall confer promptly with the affected party and agree upon, within fifteen days, a course of action to be adopted by the affected party to remove or alleviate such effect(s).. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.4: Mitigation and Coordination under Force Majeure requires action Each party shall seek reasonable methods of resuming full performance of affected party's obligations and achieving the objectives under the Order.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.5: No Price Discount for Force Majeure Delays describes In the event of any force majeure cause, either party shall not be liable for delays in performing their obligations under this Order and the delivery dates will be extended without being subject to Price Discount for delayed deliveries, as stated elsewhere.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.6: Limitation on Force Majeure Claims describes For delays arising out of Force Majeure, Supplier shall not claim extension in completion date for a period exceeding the period of delay attributable to the causes of Force Majeure and neither Buyer nor Supplier shall be liable to pay extra costs or claim any damages or compensation in addition to or in lieu of extension in completion date.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.6: Limitation on Force Majeure Claims excludes liability for payment of any hire charges for equipment or manpower, storage charges of material, stand-by charges of equipment etc.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.7: 7-Day Threshold for Force Majeure Extension describes The Supplier shall not be entitled for extension in completion / Delivery Date if the effect of Force Majeure does not exceed 7 days.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.8: End of Force Majeure Notification describes Immediately after the end of the event of Force Majeure, the affected Party having invoked such Force Majeure shall notify the other Party in writing that the event of Force Majeure has ended and such Party shall resume performance of its obligations under the Purchase Order.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.9: Overlapping Delay Rules describes In case of an overlapping delay that is when more than one event causes a delay and the cause of at least one of those events is attributable to Supplier, then to the extent and period that such delays are concurrent, the Supplier shall not be entitled to seek resort under the Force Majeure clause and seek an extension of time for the period of such delay which is attributable to the Supplier.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.10: Excluded Force Majeure Events describes The following are specifically excluded as Force Majeure and shall not constitute a basis for claims for schedule extensions, under this Purchase Order:. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.10: Excluded Force Majeure Events excludes Events or circumstances involving a previous or existing condition on or before the effective date of the Purchase Order;. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.
Item 11.12.10: Excluded Force Majeure Events excludes Delay of Material by Supplier's Vendor, Subcontractors, Sub suppliers. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.10: Excluded Force Majeure Events excludes Late performance by a Supplier and / or his sub-Supplier caused by a shortage of supervisors or labour, inefficiencies, or similar occurrences;. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.10: Excluded Force Majeure Events excludes Late delivery of equipment or materials by any sub-Supplier caused by congestion at a manufacturer's plant or elsewhere, an oversold condition of the market, inefficiencies, or similar occurrences;. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.
Item 11.12.10: Excluded Force Majeure Events excludes Any inability to obtain visas or renewal of visas for expatriate workers;. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.
Item 11.12.10: Excluded Force Majeure Events excludes Changes in market conditions. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.
Item 11.12.10: Excluded Force Majeure Events excludes Social distancing norms/ consequences of COVID 19 pandemic/quarantine requirements or the like.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.11: Suspension or Termination for Prolonged Delay describes Should the Works be delayed for more than thirty (30) consecutive days or sixty (60) days in aggregate as a result of Force Majeure, Buyer at its option may either suspend the Work affected or terminate this Purchase Order or the portion of the Work involved. The provisions governing Cancellation shall apply. However, L&T shall not be liable to pay any Cancellation charges over and above the charges as admissible under Clause of Cancellation.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.12: Consequence of Non-Compliance with Notice describes Failure by Supplier to comply with the notice requirements mentioned hereinabove shall be deemed to conclusively waive Supplier's rights to invoke Force Majeure in respect of the relevant acts, events or circumstances and to any consequent entitlements to extension of time for completion of the Work or any separable portion thereof.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Item 11.12.13: Buyer’s Right to Invoke Force Majeure describes Notwithstanding anything mentioned hereinabove, the Buyer shall have right to invoke Force Majeure if the Buyer is unable to utilize/use the services supplied by Supplier under the Purchase Order due to events mentioned above.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.

Dispute Resolution Clause 11.14.1 describes Any dispute or difference between the Parties arising out of or in connection with this Order which cannot be resolved amicably between the Parties at the level at which it arose within fifteen days thereof shall, in the first instance, be referred to the nominees of Directors of the respective Party for resolution. If the dispute cannot be settled within a further period of thirty days such dispute shall be resolved by arbitration in accordance with The Arbitration and Conciliation Act, India 1996 and any amendments thereof, by one arbitrator to be appointed by agreement between the Parties, failing which the appointment shall be made under the said Act.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.11.14 Dispute Resolution.11.14.1.

Dispute Resolution Clause 11.14.2 describes The arbitration proceedings shall be conducted in English language. The arbitration venue shall be in Mumbai, India. The Parties agree that the dispute resolution process provided herein shall be the sole remedy and the Parties shall not suspend their obligations under the Order.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.11.14 Dispute Resolution.11.14.2.

Dispute Resolution Clause 11.14.4 describes This Clause shall survive termination of this Order.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.11.14 Dispute Resolution.11.14.4.

Dispute Resolution Clause 11.14.5 describes Notwithstanding the existence of any dispute or arbitration in terms hereof or otherwise, unless otherwise directed in writing by L&T, the Supplier shall continue and be bound to continue and perform the works to completion in all respects according to the Order (unless the Order or works be determined by L&T or by the Supplier under the provisions of the Order), and the Supplier shall remain liable and bound in all respects under the Order.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.11.14 Dispute Resolution.11.14.5.

Dispute Resolution Clause 11.14.6 describes The work under the order shall, however, continue during the Arbitration proceedings and no payment due or payable to the concerned party shall be withheld (except to the extent disputed) on account of initiation, commencement or pendency of such proceedings.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.11.14 Dispute Resolution.11.14.6.

Dispute Resolution Clause 11.14.7 describes Local rules and regulations: Supplier shall ensure that the Goods within the scope of supply for this Purchase Order are in compliance with local codes and regulations. Supplier shall ensure that local rules and regulations and procedures have been complied with in obtaining certificates if and when required. Costs related to compliance with aforementioned are included in the -Order Value.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.11.14 Dispute Resolution.11.14.7.

Dispute Resolution Clause 11.14.8 describes Harmonized Tariff Codes: Supplier shall provide Buyer with the applicable Harmonized Tariff (HSN) Codes per line item for this Purchase Order / Packing List. Failure to do so may result in back charges to the Supplier.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.11.14 Dispute Resolution.11.14.8.

Assignment and Sub-Contracting Clause 11.15.1 describes Supplier shall not, except with the prior written consent of L&T, transfer or assign their obligations and interest in supply of materials, or sub-contract whole or part of the work under the Purchase Order in any manner whatsoever.. Assignment and Sub-Contracting Clause 11.15.2 describes Grant of any such consent or approval shall not however absolve the Supplier in any manner from all or any of their obligations, duties and responsibilities, including delivery of materials under this Order within the stipulated Delivery schedule.. Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.11.15 Assignment and Sub-Contracting.11.15.3.

Context: TECHNICAL_TABLE_DATA.11.15 Assignment and Sub-Contracting.11.15.4.
